temporalMaskStabilization.fillingInvariant: each higher-stage catalog mask is a superset of the prior mask
temporalMaskStabilization.drainingInvariant: runtime mask is restricted to the prior and crest footprints
temporalMaskStabilization.smallHoleRepair: eligible enclosed render-grid components of at most four pixels only

verticalPenalty.aboveMajorTreatment: zero penalty (therefore also normal one foot above major)
verticalPenalty.spatialMask: NJDEP Land Use 2015 TYPE15 = URBAN only
verticalPenalty.filling: full negative admission offset; excluded connected band is green uncertainty
verticalPenalty.highTide: full stage penalty remains at the crest
verticalPenalty.postCrestWaterSurface: full gauge stage for every blue cell; equal to source-block water surface
verticalPenalty.draining: zero admission penalty; no positive recession offset
verticalPenalty.undeveloped: zero offset on wetlands, water, beaches, and other non-urban land

graph.sourceBoundaryDefinition: all unrounded conditioned DEM cells at or below 2.00 ft NAVD88 in four-neighbour components of at least 101 cells; no manual source geometry
graph.bulkheadTerrainTreatment: stitched into input DEM with GDAL before graph construction
graph.terrainKind: bulkhead-conditioned bare earth; structures are not hydraulic walls
graph.stormDrains: disabled; not connectivity seeds and no exchange flow
graph.controlVolumeConnectivity: four-neighbour components within each tile/connection bin; hard structures isolated as barrier material

roadCorridor.filter: public primary/secondary/tertiary/residential/unclassified/living_street plus named public service streets; excludes footways, paths, tracks, parking aisles, driveways, private ways

channels.redGreen: minimum conditioned elevation across the 25 one-foot cells in each five-foot render pixel, in tenths NAVD88; unsigned big-endian value minus 32768; zero is nodata
channels.blue: minimum render activation stage across the 25 one-foot cells in tenths NAVD88 plus 50; values below -5 ft are clamped to -5 ft; 255 means not connected through 20 ft

eventHistoryDrainage.timelineBasis: canonical 15-minute history; hourly frames are exact samples of that history
eventHistoryDrainage.retentionRule: a previously admitted flood pixel remains wet on recession only while the current outside/source water surface remains above its pooled minimum ground elevation
eventHistoryDrainage.waterSurface: the current outside/source stage; retained pixels never preserve the crest depth

developedQuery.classification: developed when at least 13 of 25 one-foot cells are NJDEP TYPE15 URBAN

channels.redGreen: four-neighbour geodesic distance in whole feet from immutable qualified source-block cells; unsigned big-endian; 65535 is unreachable
